dungeons.name: Convergence Storm
dungeons.description: The three shards resonate here. Something ancient stirs at the eye of the storm.

dungeons.name: Ember Foothills
dungeons.description: Volcanic slopes crawling with Agumon. A steel door blocks the path up the ridge.

dungeons.name: Cinder Caverns
dungeons.description: Ash-choked tunnels prowled by Guilmon. Heat radiates from the sealed chamber beyond.

dungeons.name: Blazing Core
dungeons.description: The heart of the mountain. Great wings beat somewhere in the smoke.

dungeons.name: Whispering Grove
dungeons.description: Soft ferns underfoot and a canopy of Palmon leaves. A sealed gate blocks the path deeper into the grove.

dungeons.name: Rooted Hollow
dungeons.description: The trees pull tighter here. Older Palmon patrol the mossy trails guarding a slumbering warden.

dungeons.name: Palmon Sanctum
dungeons.description: The oldest heart of the grove. A living guardian stirs at the sanctum core.

dungeons.name: The Static
dungeons.description: A tear in the world. The shards react violently as you approach. This is where the world ends — or begins again.

dungeons.name: Tidal Cove
dungeons.description: A quiet inlet where Lunamon skim the pools. A rusted grate blocks the tunnel beyond.

dungeons.name: Sunken Ruins
dungeons.description: Half-flooded halls patrolled by wary Gomamon. Something large lumbers in the depths.

dungeons.name: Gomamon Deep
dungeons.description: A cavern chamber below sea level. The deep guardian waits in the last hall.

The Long Circuit — Intro

dialogue_definitions.source_twee:

Elder of the Forest

* [[Back->elder/start]] #back

The door opens only for those carrying proof of the old pact.

* [[I will look for it.->END]] #accept

dialogue_definitions.title: Chasing the Highwind — Intro
dialogue_definitions.source_twee:
:: StoryTitle
Chasing the Highwind — Intro

:: start [start]
@speaker the_world neutral

Climb up to the plateau and thin the Wind-type flocks.

* [[Climbing now.->END]] #accept
* [[Why thin them?->detail]] #ask
* [[Not yet.->END]] #decline

:: detail
@speaker the_world concerned

They have crowded out everything that nested there. Balance, or what is left of it.

* [[I'll handle it.->END]] #accept_after_detail

dialogue_definitions.title: Into the Static — Intro
dialogue_definitions.source_twee:
:: StoryTitle
Into the Static — Intro

:: start [start]
@speaker unknown neutral

The Static waits. If you go in, you come out changed or not at all.

* [[I'm going in.->END]] #accept
* [[Changed how?->detail]] #ask
* [[Then I'll stay out.->END]] #decline

:: detail
@speaker unknown neutral

If I could answer that, it would not be the Static.

* [[I'm still going.->END]] #accept_after_detail

onboarding_config.intro_dialogue:
A new signal breaks across the network...

You are a new Tamer, standing at the edge of the Digital World. Three teams of Digimon partners have answered your call — each with its own philosophy. Choose the team that will fight beside you.

onboarding_teams.name: Triad
onboarding_teams.description: Fire, earth and water — the classic elemental triangle. Hits harder and holds longer: more raw damage, more area attacks, and both a healer and the game's heaviest buffer. The cost is exposure, because every one of its elements can be countered.

onboarding_teams.name: Tide
onboarding_teams.description: Water, ice and lightning — wins by denying turns rather than trading them. Twice the initiative manipulation and the heaviest status pressure in the roster, at roughly 15% less damage. Punishing if the lock holds, fragile if it does not.

onboarding_teams.name: Equinox
onboarding_teams.description: Light, dark and water — opposites held on one line, and a team that wins by not losing. Salamon banks buffs and recovery, Hagurumon suppresses and corrodes the enemy's momentum, and Lunamon keeps the party from coming apart. No single exploit to hard-counter, but every fight becomes the war of attrition Equinox is built to outlast.
